page_title: LAZ 1-1 PAR | Lazio v Parma 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Here is a change. Sascha Britschgi is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Franco Carboni (Parma).
90+2' The manager makes a subsitution with Oliver Sorensen (Parma) coming on for Mandela Keita.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
87' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' The Parma players can’t believe it after referee Matteo Marcenaro signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

84' Play continues despite the shouts by some Parma players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Matteo Marcenaro interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
81' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) replaces Gabriel Strefezza.
80' It will be a substitution. Christian Ordonez (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Adrian Bernabe Garcia walks off.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Kenneth Taylor plays it to Tijjani Noslin (Lazio), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Zion Suzuki. 1:1.
76' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
74' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
71' A substitution has been made. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia goes off and Nahuel Estevez (Parma) comes on.

68' What a chance that is! Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
67' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
66' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Maldini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Boulaye Dia (Lazio).
63' Parma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
60' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
60' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Edoardo Motta is equal to it and makes an easy save.
59' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
58' It's time for a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) comes on in place of Gustav Isaksen.
58' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Pedro and he is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
57' A substitution has been made. Adam Marusic is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
56' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Zion Suzuki.
53' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece.
51' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Nuno Tavares (Lazio) but poses no threat. The ball is out of play. Parma will take a throw-in.
46' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play. Parma are awarded a corner kick.

44' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top left corner, but Edoardo Motta shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the top right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
42' Lazio will take a corner kick.
41' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
39' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
36' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
35' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make. Lazio win a free kick.
31' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Lazio earn a free kick.
26' Parma are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
20' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call.
15' 0 - 1 Enrico Delprato (Parma) takes a great first touch inside the box after the free kick, wins himself some space and beats the goalkeeper with an accurate strike into the bottom right corner.
15' Parma will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
14' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

11' This was a piece of cake for Edoardo Motta. Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
9' Adam Marusic (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Lazio players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
2' Adam Marusic (Lazio) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Matteo Marcenaro is introduced as the referee for today's match.
